row.title: A drain that lands only its ledger turns main red
row.body: The openstd drain added $schema to 17 instance files and shrank the baseline, but its land step committed only doctrine, ops and the changelog, so main lost the conversions and failed test_openstd on every PR. The land step now includes every file the drain touched. Also THOUGHT-CLIP-1: the Mastodon post clipped the hook and spotlight when the measured text was long; only the measured part is clipped now.
